findings.source_quote: “Blessed are the pure in heart” (Matthew 5:8). “That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere (pure) and without offense till the day of Christ” (Philippians 1:10). “Think on things that are pure” (Philippians 4:8). “Keep thyself pure” (1Timothy 5:22). Revelation 19 says “The pure in heart shall see God.” Psalm 24:3-4 asks “Who shall see God?” The answer is “he that hath clean hands and a pure heart.”

findings.location: Multiple locations — inline verse quotations later in article (e.g., I John 1:6 paragraph; Hebrews 4:13 / Numbers 32:23; James 1:15 paragraph; etc.)
findings.source_quote: I John 1:6 says, “if we say that we have fellowship with Him and walk in darkness (light on the outside and darkness on the inside), we lie and do not practice the truth.” ... Hebrews 4:13 says, “Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom (we will give account to).” ... Numbers 32:23 is still very true, saying, “Be sure your sin will find you out.” ... then James 1:15 happens: “Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death” ... Vers 16 says, “Do not (be deceived) my beloved brethren.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate these printed English scripture quotations into German, preserving verse references and HTML. Example for I John 1:6: “Wenn wir sagen, wir hätten Gemeinschaft mit ihm und wandeln in der Finsternis, so lügen wir und tun nicht die Wahrheit.” (I John 1:6). For Hebrews 4:13: “Und kein Geschöpf ist vor ihm verbor­gen; sondern alles ist offen und bloß vor seinen Augen; ihm müssen wir Rechenschaft geben.” (Hebrews 4:13). For Numbers 32:23: “Siehe, dein Missetat wird dich finden.” (Numbers 32:23). For James 1:15: “Die Begierde, sobald sie empfangen hat, gebiert Sünde; die Sünde, wenn sie vollendet ist, gebiert den Tod.” (James 1:15). Keep the same punctuation and verse references as in the source HTML.
